candidates.source_name: Ephrem the Syrian / Commentary on Numbers
candidates.source_attribution: Ephrem the Syrian, Commentary on Numbers, on 11:14-30. NPNF Series 2, vol. 13. PD.
candidates.draft_body:
Ephrem the Syrian Commentary on Numbers (c. 365 AD)

On the Lord's taking of the Spirit that was upon Moses and putting the same Spirit upon the seventy elders (Num 11:17, 25), Ephrem reads the verse as the canonical Old-Testament antecedent of Pentecost: the one Spirit is shared without diminution, the leader's portion does not decrease when others receive. The seventy elders prefigure both the seventy disciples of Lk 10:1 and the assembled hundred-and-twenty of Acts 1-2. Tewahedo pneumatology cites Num 11:17 + Joel 2:28 as the canonical doubled-Old-Testament-witness to the Pentecost gift of the Spirit on all flesh.
